summary: Token trees for speculative decoding: EAGLE-2-style dynamic draft trees, ancestor-only verify masks, a device walk accepting the path the target agrees with (greedy or sampled), and compaction of the accepted rows
implementation_scope: Python reference of candidate expansion, beam and kept-node selection, tree construction, the walk and compaction; CUDA reference kernels for top-branch expansion with log-softmax scores in a fixed candidate order, selection by score with index tie-break, tree build (tokens, parents, masks, depths, padding nodes), the tree walk with device-speculative-round's control and packed-result contract (run through RoundSteps::accept), and in-order row compaction with an idempotent settle. Verify masks are an engine attention kernel's tree masks; sampled predictions are token-sampling's Rows::tree. The drafter and target arithmetic are engine supplied.

agent_guidance.use_when: A device chain round is correct, attention-only target state, batch-1 verify of a few dozen columns costs about one step, and the drafter's second or third choice is often right where its first is wrong
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The target has recurrent layers (state per node is not implemented), verify is compute bound (large batches), drafts are sampled from the drafter's law (multi-draft rejection sampling is not implemented), or measured extra verify columns cost more than the extra accepted tokens
provides: EAGLE-2 candidate expansion and selection with deterministic ordering and ancestor-closed kept sets
Tree build: node tokens in topological order, parents, root-to-node masks, depths and unmatchable padding nodes
Device tree walk writing device-speculative-round's control block and packed result, so truncation and the single readback work unchanged
Greedy and sampled acceptance with one walk: argmax predictions, or the target's own draws at each node's depth
In-order compaction of accepted rows for contiguous and slot-mapped caches, idempotent after a Core truncation
A Python reference of every rule and a chain constructor equal to greedy speculation
engine_supplies: The drafter's forward over the beam with its own tree attention
The target's verify over all nodes with Decode::tree masks and RoPE positions frontier + depth
Predictions per node: argmax, or token-sampling's enqueue_sample with Rows::tree
The RowArray table of every attention array to compact, with Core's Round::kv slots for paged caches
Reservations: N KV slots per round, candidates and the mask and path buffers
preserve: Parents before children and masks equal to root-to-node paths
Predictions conditioned on exactly the node's path, at RoPE position frontier + depth
The walk: follow the child equal to the prediction, else emit the prediction; stop after an accepted stop or at the allowance
Compaction in increasing position and an identity path after commit
adapt: branch, beam, depth and N, chosen with measured verify cost on mixed text
Static tree shapes instead of dynamic selection
Fusing selection into the drafter's head, and per-round widths with one graph each

code_files.purpose: Host reference: expansion, EAGLE-2 drafting, tree build, chains, the walk and compaction
Candidate, build and row-array layouts; expand, select, build, tree-accept, compact and settle launch interfaces
Reference CUDA kernels for expansion, selection, tree build, the tree walk, compaction and settle

requires.hardware: CUDA C++20 (sm_80+ reference kernels) and device-speculative-round's greedy_accept.h; Python 3.11+ standard library for the reference
requires.model: Attention-only target state (no recurrent layers), a drafter that can score several paths per step, shared token ids
requires.workload: Single-request (or small-batch) speculative decoding where verify columns are cheap

contract.input: Draft logits per frontier entry, candidate buffers, kept candidates, root tokens; per round node tokens, parents, per-node predictions, the device control block, device stops and the RowArray table
contract.output: Candidates, beams, kept nodes, node tokens, parents, masks and depths; the packed result, control fields and accepted path; compacted rows and an identity path
contract.ownership: The engine owns every buffer; kernels borrow them on the caller's stream. Under device-speculative-round the controller owns control, drafts, predictions and result, the engine the tree buffers
contract.failure: Null buffers, more than 64 nodes, branch above 16 and too many rows are rejected at launch; out-of-vocabulary predictions surface at the round's token validation
contract.core_boundary: Core's StateCache reserves N rows per round (max_round_rows) and supplies Round::kv slots; Session.commit's accepted count reaches the walk's control through device-speculative-round's truncation

validation.host: Ancestor-closed kept sets, path masks and depths over 30 random drafters and tree sizes; emitted tokens always the target's predictions along a parent path with compaction keeping exactly the materialized nodes; chains walking as greedy speculation with budgets and stops
validation.native: Beams, kept nodes and built trees (tokens, parents, masks, depths) equal a host mirror on a synthetic drafter, padding nodes unmatchable; the walk's tokens, path and control fields on 200 random trees with budgets and stops, and chains equal to the greedy accept kernel; compaction of contiguous and slot-mapped rows and a no-op rerun after a smaller count
validation.performance: No speed claim; tree width must be measured against verify cost per engine
